recordFill(uint256,address,int32,uint8,a.details: Tokens flow directly from maker/taker wallets to this contract.      Creates the speculation if it doesn't exist yet. When a fill auto-creates      a speculation, the creation fee is split between maker and taker via processSplitFee.

params.lineTicks: The line number (10x format, 0 for moneyline)
params.makerPositionType: The maker's position type (Upper or Lower)

returns._0: speculationId The speculation ID for the fill

transferPosition(uint256,address,uint8,a.details: Does not enforce proportional risk/profit splits — trusts the calling contract      to define valid transfer semantics. SecondaryMarketModule is set immutably in the      module registry and is the only authorized caller.      Transfers are blocked if the remaining position would fall below leaderboard-locked amounts.      On transfer-in, the destination inherits firstFillTimestamp from the source:      - If the destination is fresh (riskAmount == 0), the source's timestamp is copied directly.      - If the destination already has exposure, the earlier timestamp wins (min of source and destination).      - Recipients of secondary-market transfers are flagged as leaderboard-ineligible.

claimPosition(uint256,uint8).notice: Claims winnings from a settled position. Permissionless for the position holder.

recordFill(uint256,address,int32,uint8,a.notice: Records a fill. Only callable by MatchingModule.

s_positions(uint256,address,uint8).notice: Speculation ID → user → position type → Position

transferPosition(uint256,address,uint8,a.notice: Transfers a position between addresses. Only callable by SecondaryMarketModule.
